title: Ely Buendia and Chito Miranda deliver sold-out Dubai show despite regional uncertainty

blocks.text: Filipino music icons Ely Buendia and Chito Miranda brought thousands of fans together for a sold-out Dubai concert at the Coca-Cola Arena last August 30, featuring an unforgettable night of nostalgia, energy and some of the most recognizable songs in Original Pilipino Music (OPM). The achievement was particularly significant amid regional tensions in the Middle East. With travel concerns and consumer caution affecting entertainment and other industries, staging a major live event carried considerable risk. The strong audience response demonstrated both the market’s resilience and the enduring appeal of two of the Philippines’ most influential artists. Buendia and Miranda’s music has […]...
